scientific_integrity: All stated asymptotic limits derive from explicit payoff difference, exact strict convexity and root-sign bracketing; numerical checks do not substitute for the infinite-n proof. Earlier finite-group endpoint criterion and existing equilibrium types are credited.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic well-mixed infinite-population replicator with r/G fixed above 1, exponentially vanishing synergy probability, fixed 0<delta<1, fixed s>0; no finite stochastic population, heterogeneous contact, fixed-r or finite-n uniform error theorem. Publication priority beyond inspected literature is not independently established.
title: A sharp rare-synergy exponent and two equilibrium boundary layers in nonlinear public-goods dynamics
